triggers.fact: Blinkit received a ₹600 crore cash boost from parent Eternal to support aggressive dark store expansion and growth initiatives.
Blinkit is expanding its quick commerce operations into Tier-2 cities.
Eternal injected an additional Rs 450 crore into Blinkit via a rights issue to fund ongoing expansion.
Blinkit's official careers page states that they only accept job applications through employee referrals.

pain_hypothesis: As Blinkit aggressively expands dark stores and pushes into Tier-2 markets, relying strictly on employee referrals creates a bottleneck in sourcing entry-level operations and management talent across multiple college campuses efficiently.
